about.kicker: A DIFFERENT KIND OF DENTAL VISIT
about.title: Care that begins with
about.lead: SmileCraft is a neighborhood dental home built around a simple idea: when people feel cared for, better things follow.
about.storyTitle: Modern dentistry, with a more human touch.
about.storyOne: At Smile Care Dental Clinic, thoughtful care and modern tools come together in a calm, welcoming space. We believe great dentistry should feel clear, considered, and personal—not rushed or intimidating.
about.storyTwo: From your first hello to your follow-up, our team takes time to understand what matters to you and help you feel at ease.
about.missionText: Make high-quality dental care feel welcoming, understandable, and accessible to every family we serve.
about.visionText: A community where every person can feel confident asking questions and sharing their smile.
about.promiseText: Listen first, explain clearly, and make your comfort part of every care decision.
about.ctaTitle: Come as you are. Leave smiling.

services.kicker: THOUGHTFUL CARE, ALL IN ONE PLACE
services.title: Good care for
services.lead: We’ll help you understand your options and find a path that feels right for you.
services.preventiveText: Routine check-ups, professional cleanings, and personalized guidance to help you keep your natural smile healthy.
services.cosmeticText: Explore options to brighten, shape, and refresh your smile with a plan made around your goals.
services.restorativeText: Comfort-focused care to restore function and support long-term oral health.
services.familyText: Dental care for children, adults, and everyone in between, all in one welcoming clinic.
services.gumText: Gentle evaluation and care to support healthy gums and a comfortable smile.
services.question: Not sure where to start?
services.questionText: We’re happy to help you find the right care for your smile.

doctors.title: Good people.
doctors.lead: Our care team is here to make the details feel simple and every visit feel a little easier.
doctors.teamTitle: Expertise matters. So does how you feel.
doctors.teamText: Our clinicians bring experience across a range of dental care, with a shared commitment to thoughtful, patient-first treatment. Tell us what matters to you, and we’ll help find the right person for your care.
doctors.listenText: Your questions and comfort shape every conversation and care plan.
doctors.explainText: Clear recommendations help you make confident choices about your care.
doctors.careText: Gentle, attentive care is part of every visit—not an extra.
doctors.dataNote: Clinician profiles will appear here as the clinic directory is set up.

contact.kicker: WE’RE HERE WHEN YOU NEED US
contact.title: Let’s make your next visit
contact.lead: Questions about care or getting here? Our friendly team is happy to help.
contact.dataNote: Clinic address and contact information are sample details and should be confirmed before launch.
contact.ctaText: Appointments are arranged by our care team. Reach out and we’ll help find a convenient time for you.
contact.urgent: For urgent concerns, call the clinic directly.
